description: Read one launch kit's plan, for Last Price staff only: its checks, its steps in the order the launch runs them (marking the ones that send something outside Last Price), its go code, and the exact words the owner says to launch it ("go CODE", "go CODE at <UTC time>", or "go CODE without announcements"). Read only: it never switches, schedules or sends anything; launching needs the owner's go code through the launch command. Needs an API key holding the launches:read scope by name, made by someone who is still Last Price staff, sent as x-api-key or as Authorization: Bearer lp_...; any other credential gets 404. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

flag.description: The release flag the kit launches, such as capability-servers: flag on a list_feature_launches result.

name: get_feature_launch_plan
